verdict.rationale: Apple's spec page explicitly states 153GB/s memory bandwidth for the base M5 and describes a unified memory architecture, giving a developer a concrete bandwidth figure and general memory type concept, but it lacks a stated memory technology (e.g., LPDDR generation) and does not publish a capacity ceiling — the 32GB max cited comes only from community discussion, not vendor docs. missing for 10: vendor-stated memory technology/type, vendor-published max capacity configuration, independent corroboration of the bandwidth figure.
